dates.before_1970: commit dates clamped to 1970-01-01; the In-force trailer is authoritative

scope.when_absent: no scope note is recorded in this history; not a statement that a change reaches every case

default_reach.meaning: a law applies to facts arising after it takes effect unless it says otherwise; criminal penalties never apply retroactively
default_reach.authority: ABGB § 5 (Gesetze wirken nicht zurück); Landesverfassung Art. 33 Abs. 2
